pr_title: [CI] Extend bisect parameters through AOP workflows
source_quote:
This block of code for constructing bisect command arguments is nearly identical to the `build_bisect_extra_args` function in `tests/e2e/nightly/multi_node/scripts/run.sh`. This code duplication increases the maintenance burden, as future changes to bisect parameters will need to be updated in two places.
> To improve maintainability, I recommend refactoring this logic into a shared shell script or function that can be sourced by both `aop_process.sh` and `run.sh`. This will create a single source of truth for building the bisect arguments.

rule.description: 当多个 shell 脚本包含几乎相同的代码块时，应提取为独立的共享脚本文件（通过 `source` 引入），创建单一数据源，避免维护时需要多处修改。
checkpoints: 检查多个脚本之间是否存在几乎相同的代码块（如参数构造、路径处理）
确认重复代码是否已提取为共享函数文件
确认各脚本通过 `source` 引入共享函数而非复制粘贴
使用 `shellcheck` 的 `# shellcheck source=` 注解标注 source 路径

antipattern.code:
# 以下代码与 run.sh 中的 build_bisect_extra_args 函数几乎完全相同
# ... 前置代码 ...
BISECT_CMD=()
BISECT_CMD+=(--model-name "$MODEL_NAME")
BISECT_CMD+=(--config-root "$CONFIG_ROOT")

# ❌ 10 行重复的 bisect 参数构造逻辑
[ -n "$BISECT_GOOD_COMMIT" ] && BISECT_CMD+=(--good-commit "$BISECT_GOOD_COMMIT")
[ -n "$BISECT_FAIL_CONFIRM_RETRIES" ] && BISECT_CMD+=(--fail-confirm-retries "$BISECT_FAIL_CONFIRM_RETRIES")
[ -n "$BISECT_TRIAL_TIMEOUT" ] && BISECT_CMD+=(--trial-timeout-s "$BISECT_TRIAL_TIMEOUT")
[ -n "$BISECT_BARRIER_TIMEOUT" ] && BISECT_CMD+=(--barrier-timeout-s "$BISECT_BARRIER_TIMEOUT")
[ "$BISECT_NO_VERIFY_GOOD" = "true" ] && BISECT_CMD+=(--no-verify-good)
[ "$BISECT_NO_VERIFY_BAD" = "true" ] && BISECT_CMD+=(--no-verify-bad)
[ "$BISECT_FORCE_INITIAL_BUILD" = "true" ] && BISECT_CMD+=(--force-initial-build)
# AOP owns the conservative rebuild policy; users cannot override it.
BISECT_CMD+=(--native-check since-build)
[ -n "$BISECT_CONFIG_BASE_PATH" ] && BISECT_CMD+=(--config-base-path "$BISECT_CONFIG_BASE_PATH")
